title: Hill Neighborhood
content: Sometimes I visit my old friend in mall world. It takes me a while to get to him. I drive through the country. Green pastures, very very hilly. I pass a bridge with a train tunnel underneath. His neighborhood is in a valley but right next to it there is this Main Street where the shops are built into the hills. There are antique stores and a coffee shop. It’s like they were carved out. Does this sound familiar to anyone? It’s very very hilly.
